# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to preaching his religion to groups of
people. This can normally be resolved as a special bonus of +10 to the Public
Speaking skill.
@@ 2
For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that
the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target’s best interest.
@@ 3
Caster’s voice is amplified two times. This is useful for talking to large
crowds.
@@ 4
For as long as the caster speaks, the target will believe that the reasoning
and ideas that the caster expresses are correct and valid.
@@ 5
Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of
language developed (i.e., DP’s spent), results in two ranks being learned. It
is assumed that this spell is cast and in effect while the language is being
learned.
@@ 6
As Conversion I, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 7
As Sounding II, except amplification is four times.
@@ 8
As Voice of Friendship, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 9
The caster is subtly directed (hints and clues) towards a specific person or
group of people that the caster’s deity believes should hear the caster’s
message. The exact form of the guidance will vary from deity to deity (e.g., a
deity of the wind would have the wind constantly blow the same way, etc.). For
the duration of the spell, the caster must concentrate to be led in the
correct direction.
@@ 10
As Learn Language II, except rate is tripled (three ranks are gained for every
one).
@@ 11
As Conversion I, except the bonus is +30.
@@ 12
As Voice of Reason, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 13
Caster’s basic needs are met by his deity in various ways (i.e., people bring
the caster food, and offer him shelter for the evening, etc.).
@@ 15
As Sounding II, except amplification is ten times.
@@ 16
As Learn Language II, except rate is quadrupled (four ranks are gained for
every one).
@@ 18
[RR Mod: -50] After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he
knows it). All targets who fail their RR will believe the caster is speaking
the absolute truth.
@@ 20
As Conversion I, except the bonus is +40.
@@ 25
Caster is able to speak any language (even one that he has never heard before)
as if he was a native speaker.
@@ 30
As Voice of Conviction, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.
@@ 50
If the caster’s deity agrees, a divine sign or miracle will be shown to an
appropriate group of people.
